{{Top|leg}}
'''22K97 (MD) requisition forms''' were requisition forms used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit/Legends|Mobile Surgical Unit]] by [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The forms could be used to requisition medical [[Droid/Legends|droids]] to be sent for use in the surgical units during the war. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Doctor/Legends|surgeon]] [[Jos Vondar]] filled out multiple 22K97 (MD) forms in an attempt to gain two more medical droids for his staff during the [[Battle of Drongar|Battle]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]]. Each attempt however was unsuccessful.<ref name="MI:BS">''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
'''22K97 (MD) requisition forms''' were first mentioned in [[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]] the first book in the [[MedStar Duology]], written by [[Michael Reaves]] and [[Steve Perry]], and published in [[2004]].<ref name="MI:BS" />
